bugs.error_message: Issue #5551: substr_replace() return type stays string|string[] regardless of subject, causing PhanPartialTypeMismatchArgumentInternal with strict_param_checking when result passed to strtolower()
bugs.root_cause: DependentReturnTypeOverridePlugin had no handler for substr_replace (subject is arg 0). Also preg_replace_callback_array was registered with the third-argument handler but its subject is arg 1, and str_ireplace had no basic handler at all.
bugs.fix: Refactored third_argument_string_or_array_handler into $make_subject_string_or_array_handler(int $subject_index) factory in src/Phan/Plugin/Internal/DependentReturnTypeOverridePlugin.php; registered substr_replace (index 0), preg_replace_callback_array (index 1), str_ireplace (index 2). Test: tests/files/src/substr_replace_dependent_return.php

bugs.error_message: Issue #5553: PhanTypeMismatchArgumentNullable / PhanPluginNeverReturnMethod false positives when a branch calls a never-returning instance method on a local variable ($foo = new Foo(); $foo->neverReturns();) - branch not treated as unreachable
bugs.root_cause: BlockExitStatusChecker::computeStatusOfMethodCall only resolved $this->method() calls; any other variable hit a 'TODO not yet handled' branch returning STATUS_PROCEED. UseReturnValuePlugin's node-flag marking couldn't compensate because plugin analyzeMethod hooks (AlwaysReturnPlugin) run in Analysis::analyzeFunctions before analyzeFile marks flags, and phan -n runs no plugins at all.
bugs.fix: BlockExitStatusChecker now tracks the current statement list/index in computeStatusOfBlock and computeStatusOfMethodCall scans preceding sibling statements for `$var = new ClassName(...)`, bailing conservatively if any intervening statement may reassign the variable (nested assign, unset, by-ref closure use, dynamic var, destructuring). Sound because PHP covariance only allows never to override never. Tests: tests/files/src/5932_never_instance_method_unreachable.php, tests/plugin_test/src/321_noreturn_method_instance_variable.php; updated tests/plugin_test/expected/217_noreturn_control_flow_extra.php.expected (new correct PhanPluginNeverReturnFunction inference).

bugs.error_message: Issue #5565: after `if (array_is_list($x)) return;` a variable of type `array` is inferred as non-empty-associative-array<array>, causing false PhanTypeMismatchProperty
bugs.root_cause: $remove_list_callback used UnionType::asNonEmptyAssociativeArrayTypes(), a constructor helper that wraps each type as an ELEMENT type, instead of converting each array type to its associative form
bugs.fix: Added polymorphic ArrayType::castToNonEmptyAssociativeArrayTypes() (overrides in GenericArrayType, ListType, ArrayShapeType, CallableArrayType) and UnionType::nonEmptyAssociativeArrayTypesStrictCast(), mirroring castToListTypes()/listTypesStrictCast(); updated 1129_array_is_list expected output and added array_is_list_negation test

bugs.error_message: PR #5567 Codex review (P1): ArrayShapeType::castToNonEmptyAssociativeArrayTypes() returned empty for array{0?:int,1?:string}, which permits the non-list [1 => 'x']
bugs.root_cause: canCastToList() only means the shape is list-compatible; optional keys are independent, so with 2+ trailing optional keys an instantiation can skip an earlier key and not be a list
bugs.fix: Return empty only when at most one field is possibly undefined; otherwise keep the shape non-nullable. Added array{0?:int,1?:string} (kept) and array{0?:int} (dropped) cases to array_is_list_negation test

bugs.error_message: Issue #5566: PhanParamTooFewInternal / PhanParamTooFewInternalUnpack for one-argument calls to array_diff/array_intersect family: 'requires 2 arg(s)'
bugs.root_cause: Signature map still had the PHP 7 shape ('array', 'arrays', '...args=') requiring two arrays; PHP 8.0+ is (array $array, array ...$arrays). Callback variants (array_udiff etc.) likewise required a second array before the callback.
bugs.fix: Changed the six plain entries to 'array'=>'array', '...arrays='=>'array'. Added a '2 alternate signature (array + callback(s)) for the ten callback variants; Phan selects alternates by arg count.

bugs.error_message: PR #5568 Codex review (P2): the new '2 alternate (array + callback) let array_diff_ukey($a, 'strcmp', 'strcmp') pass type checking although PHP throws TypeError for argument 2
bugs.root_cause: analyzeParameter() iterates all alternates per argument and only skipped alternates requiring MORE args than passed; an alternate with FEWER max params than the call's arg count (non-variadic) still participated in type matching
bugs.fix: In the same guard block, skip an alternate when argcount > getNumberOfParameters() and getParameterForCaller(argcount-1) is null (i.e. not variadic). Added the review's calls to array_diff_single_argument test.

bugs.error_message: PR #5568 Codex review round 2 (P2): the alternate max-count guard was bypassed for any unpacking, so array_diff_ukey($a, ...['strcmp','strcmp']) was no longer reported
bugs.root_cause: Guard used count(children) and skipped entirely on isUnpack(); ArgumentType::getArgCount() already computes an exact count for fixed-size unpacked arrays and flags unknown sizes
bugs.fix: Guard now uses getArgCount() (computed lazily once per analyzeParameter call) and applies both count checks whenever the count is known, unpacking included. Named-argument comment needed no code change: PhanSuspiciousNamedArgumentVariadicInternal already covers it.

bugs.error_message: define()d constants have real type erased (no PhanImpossibleTypeComparison for STRING_CONST === $int); constant('NAME') returns mixed for them (#5542)
bugs.root_cause: 4a449b66 erased the real type of dynamic constants instead of widening it; ParseVisitor::addConstant keeps only the first define() site so trusting the real type would make conditional define()s (if/else) unsound; DependentReturnTypeOverridePlugin returned mixed for dynamic constants in constant()
bugs.fix: Widen real type of define()d constants to non-literal (true/false->bool, 3->int) instead of erasing; union all define() sites via GlobalConstant::addAlternateDefinitionType (keyed file:line, lazily resolved, undo-tracked); constant() returns the union type

bugs.error_message: PhanTypeMismatchArgumentNullable after `if ($x?->m())` / `if ($x?->prop === true)` etc.: nullsafe condition does not narrow receiver to non-null (#5569)
bugs.root_cause: ConditionVisitor had no visitNullsafeMethodCall and visitNullsafeProp only delegated to the $this->prop path; analyzeBinaryConditionSide ignored nullsafe chain nodes
bugs.fix: Added isNullsafeAccessChain/removeNullFromNullsafeReceivers/doesConditionImplyNonNull helpers in ConditionVisitorUtil; hooked into removeNullFromVariable, removeFalseyFromVariable, analyzeBinaryConditionSide, and ConditionVisitor truthy/isset/instanceof visitors; nullsafe prop receivers narrowed via synthetic AST_PROP node

bugs.error_message: Conditional return type (#5574/PR 5576) ignored `...$unpack` when the function also declares @template: templated(1, ...$maybeEmpty) narrowed to one branch (Codex + Copilot review)
bugs.root_cause: addClosureForDependentTemplateType's analyzer passed $args_types (every arg already converted to UnionType) to resolveConditionalReturnType, erasing AST_UNPACK/AST_NAMED_ARG markers that computeArgumentTypeForConditionalReturn checks
bugs.fix: Pass the raw $args to resolveConditionalReturnType from the template analyzer; the resolver evaluates only the conditioned argument

bugs.error_message: `@return ($b is T ? T : null)` compared the argument against the unsubstituted template T (Codex review)
bugs.root_cause: The template map was applied only to the resolved result, not to the condition type before evaluateCondition()
bugs.fix: resolveConditionalReturnType() takes an optional $template_type_map and maps the whole ConditionalReturnType (condition + branches) before resolving; the template analyzer passes its inferred map

bugs.error_message: call_user_func_array('f', ['name' => $v]) resolved dependent return types positionally (Copilot review)
bugs.root_cause: extractArrayArgs() dropped array keys and unpack elements, so keyed arrays (php 8 named args) were treated as positional for every dependent-return closure, now including conditionals
bugs.fix: extractArrayArgs() returns null (=> fall back to the plain union return type) when any element has a key or is `...$x`

bugs.error_message: `@return ($b is T ? int : string)` (template only in the condition) emitted PhanTemplateTypeNotUsedInFunctionReturn and never installed the template closure (Copilot review, PR 5576)
bugs.root_cause: isTemplateTypeUsed() only inspected the flattened return union (int|string) and @phan-assert types, not the conditional's condition type
bugs.fix: Added ConditionalReturnType::usesTemplateType() and checked it in isTemplateTypeUsed()

bugs.error_message: internal/Issue-Types-Caught-by-Phan.md example anchors for PhanCommentReturnConditionalWithoutRealParam went stale after the test file grew (Copilot review)
bugs.root_cause: WikiIssueTypesTest only regenerates entries for undocumented issues; it does not re-check line anchors of existing entries, so extending a test file silently invalidates them
bugs.fix: Updated the anchors by hand (#L46 / #L222). When a test file referenced by that doc changes, recompute the anchors manually

bugs.error_message: Conditional return branch `int|string` survived a native `: int` signature because the compatibility guard used any-member canCastToUnionType() (Copilot review, PR 5576)
bugs.root_cause: resolveConditionalReturnType() checked the whole resolved union with canCastToUnionType(), which succeeds if any member casts
bugs.fix: Added withoutTypesIncompatibleWithRealReturnType(): per-member canAnyTypeStrictCastToUnionType against the real return type (static resolved via Method::getDeclaringClassContext()), falling back to getUnionType() only when nothing survives, mirroring Method::computeNewTypeForComment()

bugs.error_message: f(...$args, x: 1): conditional on optional $y resolved from its default instead of staying ambiguous (Codex review, PR 5576)
bugs.root_cause: normalizeNamedArgs() stored the AST_UNPACK node at index 0 and then overwrote it with the named argument targeting position 0, erasing the unpack marker that dependent-return resolution relies on
bugs.fix: When a named argument targets a position already holding an AST_UNPACK node, keep the unpack and append the named arg as an unmatched AST_NAMED_ARG node

bugs.error_message: `@return ($x is callable ? A : B)` selected A for 'not callable' / any non-empty string or array (Copilot review, PR 5576)
bugs.root_cause: UnionType::isStrictSubtypeOf() follows Phan's cast matrix, where non-empty-string/literal strings/arrays cast to callable, so they counted as definite subtypes
bugs.fix: For conditions made only of callable/callable-string/callable-array/callable-object, decide with Type::isCallable() (all true => first branch) and Type::isDefiniteNonCallableType() (all true => second branch), otherwise keep both branches

bugs.error_message: call_user_func_array($cb, [0 => $arg]) lost dependent/conditional return analysis after the keyed-array fix (Copilot review, PR 5576)
bugs.root_cause: extractArrayArgs() rejected every explicit key, but PHP passes integer keys positionally in array order; only string keys (named args), non-literal keys and unpacking make positions unknown
bugs.fix: Accept null and literal int keys as positional; return null for anything else

bugs.error_message: `@return ($x is callable-string ? A : B)` kept both branches for a Closure argument instead of selecting B (Copilot review, PR 5576)
bugs.root_cause: evaluateCallableCondition() only returned false when every argument type was definitely non-callable; a callable of the wrong kind (Closure vs callable-string) fell through to the ambiguous result
bugs.fix: Also return false when the argument type has no overlap with the specific callable condition type (hasAnyTypeOverlap)

bugs.error_message: PhanCommentReturnConditionalWithoutRealParam reported on the plain @return line when a conditional @psalm-return followed it (Copilot review, PR 5576)
bugs.root_cause: The conditional was attached to the pre-existing ReturnComment and the warning used ReturnComment::getLineno(), i.e. the first annotation's line
bugs.fix: ConditionalReturnType now records its own line number (threaded through the recursive parser) and warnAboutUndeclaredConditionalReturnParams() uses it

bugs.error_message: `@return A|B|false` + `@psalm-return ($x is null ? A : B)`: call sites resolved to A or B and dropped `false` (Copilot review, PR 5576)
bugs.root_cause: Builder merged the plain annotation into the flattened ReturnComment type, but resolveConditionalReturnType() returned only the chosen conditional branch
bugs.fix: Compute the members of getPHPDocReturnType() not present in the conditional's flattened union (template-mapped when applicable) and union them into every resolved result

bugs.error_message: CI __FakeSelfFallbackTest failed: src/Phan/Language/Element/FunctionTrait.php:1252 PhanPluginAvoidableGetterInTrait Can replace $this->getPHPDocReturnType() with $this->phpdoc_return_type (PR 5576)
bugs.root_cause: tests/run_test enables extra plugins (e.g. AvoidableGetterPlugin) for __FakeSelfFallbackTest that plain `./phan` self-analysis does not, so a getter call inside the trait that owns the property passed locally
bugs.fix: Read $this->phpdoc_return_type directly

bugs.error_message: narrowedBySignature(1) with `: int` and `@return ($x is null ? int : string)` resolved to int|string: the fallback reintroduced the incompatible branch (Copilot review, PR 5576)
bugs.root_cause: When nothing in the chosen branch survived the signature filter, resolveConditionalReturnType() fell back to getUnionType(), which is the phpdoc-enriched union rather than the native signature
bugs.fix: Fall back to getRealReturnType() when it is non-empty (then apply static expansion), and to getUnionType() only when there is no real return type

bugs.error_message: Inherited and trait-imported conditionals lost the members only the plain @return mentioned (`@return A|B|false` + psalm conditional A : B => child/trait call narrowed to A) (Copilot review, PR 5576)
bugs.root_cause: The extras were recovered at resolve time from the function's phpdoc_return_type, which inheritPHPDoc() and Method::createUseAlias() don't copy
bugs.fix: Bake the extras into the conditional's leaves at parse time (ConditionalReturnType::withPlainAnnotationTypes()) so every clone/inheritance path carries them; drop the phpdoc lookup from resolveConditionalReturnType()

bugs.error_message: `($x is int ? A : ($x is string ? B : C))` with int|string resolved to A|B|C instead of A|B (Copilot review, PR 5576)
bugs.root_cause: When the outer verdict was ambiguous, both nested branches were resolved against the original argument type
bugs.fix: Resolve the matching branch with the argument narrowed to the condition (types overlapping it, or the condition for mixed) and the other branch with ConditionVisitor::excludeMatchingTypes(); note ConditionVisitorUtil is a trait, so call the static through ConditionVisitor

bugs.error_message: `($x is null ? ($x is string ? A : B) : C)` with ?string gave A|B|C instead of B|C: the nested branch saw the whole nullable type (Codex review, PR 5576)
bugs.root_cause: Phan represents ?string as a single nullable Type, so the per-type overlap filter kept all of it for `is null` and excludeMatchingTypes couldn't drop just the null part
bugs.fix: Split nullable union types into non-nullable|null (withNullSplitOff) before narrowing/excluding for nested conditions

bugs.error_message: Two conditional annotations on one docblock: the second one's branch types were dropped from per-call resolution (Codex review, PR 5576)
bugs.root_cause: The merge in maybeParseReturn() only handled plain+conditional combinations; conditional+conditional kept the first and ignored the second
bugs.fix: Keep the first conditional's structure and add the second's flattened types to every leaf (withPlainAnnotationTypes)

bugs.error_message: `@return ($x is null ? A : B)` + `@psalm-return ($x is null ? B : A)`: null call resolved to A only (Codex review, PR 5576)
bugs.root_cause: withPlainAnnotationTypes() subtracted every type already present anywhere in the first conditional before adding to leaves, so an overlapping second conditional contributed nothing
bugs.fix: For conditional+conditional, add the second one's whole flattened type to every leaf (withTypesAddedToLeaves)

bugs.error_message: `($x is non-empty-string ? ($x is '' ? A : B) : C)` with string gave A|B|C: nested branch saw the whole `string` instead of `non-empty-string` (Codex review, PR 5576)
bugs.root_cause: narrowToCondition() kept an entire atomic type whenever it overlapped the condition
bugs.fix: When the condition is a strict subtype of the argument's atom, narrow to the condition instead of keeping the atom

bugs.error_message: f(...$args, x: 1): conditional on $x stayed ambiguous although any non-throwing call passes 1 for $x (Codex review, PR 5576; reverses its earlier suggestion)
bugs.root_cause: The previous fix kept the AST_UNPACK node in the matched slot and appended the named arg; PHP throws if the unpacked array also supplies x, so the explicit value is the only possibility
bugs.fix: Put the named value at its position and move the unpack node to the appended tail; the resolver now uses an explicit value when present and treats missing positions as ambiguous only if an unpack exists anywhere

bugs.error_message: LiteralIntType(5)->isStrictSubtypeOf(negative-int) returned true (found while testing conditional returns)
bugs.root_cause: isSubtypeOfNonNullableType() returned true for any IntType subclass other than LiteralIntType/NonZeroIntType, including PositiveIntType, NegativeIntType and IntRangeType
bugs.fix: Check the literal value against positive-int, negative-int and int ranges (containsValue). Note: positive-int/negative-int still 'overlap' per canCastToNonNullableType; that laxity is pre-existing and out of scope

bugs.error_message: `($x is non-empty-string|int ? ($x is '' ? A : B) : C)` with string kept `string` in the nested branch (Codex review, PR 5576)
bugs.root_cause: narrowToCondition() tested whether the whole condition union was a subtype of the argument atom; with a union condition that never holds even when one member is
bugs.fix: Intersect each condition member with each argument atom separately

bugs.error_message: Method implementing two interfaces (conditional @return first, plain narrower @return second) returned the conditional's other branch (B) from a call whose declared type was A
bugs.root_cause: ParameterTypesAnalyzer::maybeInheritCommentReturnType narrowed the child's union type from the later overridden method but left the conditional_return_type inherited from the earlier one in place, so getDependentReturnType resolved a stale conditional
bugs.fix: Clear the child's conditional before adopting a different (narrower) inherited union type, then re-inherit from the current overridden method; test cases CondThenPlain/PlainThenCond/CondThenSameUnion in tests/files/src/5938_conditional_return_type.php

bugs.error_message: Conditional @return on a function with @phan-real-return lost the real type set at call sites (plain @return kept it)
bugs.root_cause: getDependentReturnType only re-attached getRealReturnType() (native signature); @phan-real-return lives only in getUnionType()->getRealTypeSet()
bugs.fix: FunctionTrait::resolveConditionalReturnType attaches getUnionType()->getRealTypeSet() when the resolved branch has none

bugs.error_message: PhanPossiblyNonClassMethodCall on `$x?->foo() ? $x->bar() : $x` ternary in Method::cloneWithTemplateParameterTypeMap
bugs.root_cause: Phan does not narrow a nullsafe-call truthiness check in a ternary condition onto the same expression in the true branch
bugs.fix: Assign the nullable value to a local and use an explicit `if ($local && ...)`
